紧凑文件夹——单子目录压缩为单行路径: Compact folders — compress single-child directories into a combined path
点击目录行即可展开/折叠——关闭后只有 twistie 小三角管展开折叠，点目录: Click directory rows to expand/collapse — when off, only the twistie triangle handles expand/collapse, clicking selects only
切换编辑器标签页时自动在文件树中定位: Auto-reveal in file tree when switching editor tabs
删除文件/文件夹前弹出确认框: Show confirmation dialog before deleting files/folders
拖放移动文件前弹出确认框: Show confirmation dialog before drag-and-drop file moves
启用文件树拖放: Enable file tree drag and drop
打开文件夹时自动展开根节点: Auto-expand root node when opening a folder
重名文件自动加数字后缀（如 test-1.txt）: Auto-add numeric suffix for duplicate file names (e.g. test-1.txt)
从资源管理器拖入文件后自动打开: Auto-open files after dragging from file explorer
文件嵌套——相关文件折叠为父文件的子节点: File nesting — collapse related files as children of the parent file
右键'在终端中打开'时使用的外部终端。选'自定义'后在下方的命令模板中填写启动命: External terminal for "Open in Terminal". Select "Custom" to enter a launch command in the template below.
自定义终端启动命令。用 {{dirPath}} 表示目标目录。例: wt -d: Custom terminal launch command. Use {{dirPath}} as the target directory. E.g.: wt -d "{{dirPath}}"
确定替换所有 {{totalMatches}} 处？此操作不可撤销。: Replace all {{totalMatches}} occurrences? This cannot be undone.
浏览和管理文件——对标 VS Code 资源管理器: Browse and manage files — modeled on the VS Code Explorer
没有选中的文件——请先在文件树中选中一个文件: No file selected — select a file in the file tree first
在文件树里展开目录链并选中目标项，把它滚进视野。参数给 filePath 或 u: Expand the matching directory chain in the file tree, select the target, and scroll it into view. Pass filePath or uri; omit both to use the focused item. No effect when the target is not inside any open workspace.
在目标目录里新建一个空文件。重名时按 file-tree.incremental: Create an empty file in the target directory. On a name clash, add a numeric suffix according to file-tree.incrementalNaming (smart by default; test.txt → test-1.txt). The target is the context-menu item's directory (the folder itself or the file's parent), falling back to the focused item or the first workspace root.
在目标目录里新建一个文件夹，命名规则与目标目录回退同「新建文件」。: Create a folder in the target directory. Naming and target-directory fallback follow New File.
按扩展名找属主插件开一个标签页（固定标签）。传右键项（FileMenuConte: Open a pinned tab using the plugin that owns the file extension. Expects a context-menu item (FileMenuContext); directories are ignored.
在编辑器里打开文件（固定标签）。当前与「打开」走同一条开标签页链路，不保证落在另: Open the file in the editor as a pinned tab. Currently uses the same tab-opening path as Open and does not guarantee a split pane. Directories are ignored.
已由宿主命令 `workbench.action.openWith` 承接（面板: Superseded by the host command `workbench.action.openWith` (the host owns the picker and data assembly). Kept only for transition compatibility: it normalizes the argument (bare path / { uri, anchor } / { uri, ext } / { ext }) into a host request and forwards it; the host normalizes the extension. New code should call the host command directly (`SHELL_COMMANDS.openWith` / `openWith()` from `@linkdesk/plugin-sdk/shell-commands`).
对当前聚焦项逐情处理：目录→展开/折叠，文件→开标签页。等于在文件树上按 Ent: Act on the focused item: expand/collapse a directory, or open a file in a tab. Equivalent to pressing Enter in the file tree. No effect without a focused item.
Open the target directory in an external terminal (for a file, use its parent directory). The terminal type comes from file-tree.external.windowsExec; when set to custom, the launch command comes from file-tree.external.customCommand ({{dirPath}} is the directory placeholder).
在系统文件管理器（Windows 资源管理器）里定位并选中该项。参数必须是右键项: Reveal and select the item in the system file manager (Windows Explorer). Requires a context-menu item (FileMenuContext); no effect without uri.
把该项的完整路径写进系统剪贴板。参数必须是右键项（FileMenuContext: Copy the item's full path to the system clipboard. Requires a context-menu item (FileMenuContext); no effect without uri.
把相对于所属工作区根的路径写进系统剪贴板；没有匹配的根时退回完整路径。参数必须是: Copy the path relative to its workspace root to the system clipboard; falls back to the full path when no root matches. Requires a context-menu item (FileMenuContext).
剪切——记进插件内剪贴板，同时把路径写进系统剪贴板文件列表（可直接在系统资源管理: Cut: record the selection in the plugin clipboard and also put the paths on the system clipboard file list (pasteable in Explorer). Acts on the current multi-selection, falling back to the context-menu item, then the focused item.
复制——同「剪切」的双写（插件内剪贴板 ＋ 系统剪贴板），但粘贴时是复制而非移动: Copy: the same dual write as Cut (plugin clipboard + system clipboard), but Paste copies instead of moving. Target resolution matches Cut.
把剪贴板里的路径落到目标目录：剪切来的移动、复制来的复制，重名冲突走与拖放同一套: Paste clipboard paths into the target directory: cut entries move, copied entries copy, and name clashes follow the same safety flow as drag-and-drop. The target is the context-menu item's directory or the focused item's directory, falling back to the first workspace root.
在当前聚焦行进入行内重命名（等于按 F2）。无聚焦项时无效果。: Start inline rename on the focused row (same as F2). No effect without a focused item.
删除当前选中集；无多选时取右键项，再回退聚焦项。file-tree.confir: Delete the current selection; without a multi-selection, use the context-menu item, then the focused item. When file-tree.confirmDelete is true (the default), confirm first. Items are deleted and failures reported one by one; only successfully deleted items refresh their parent directory.
占位命令——未接实现，调用无效果。: Placeholder command: not implemented; invoking it has no effect.
重读所有工作区根，并把已展开目录的子节点重新拉一遍（未展开的层不动）。: Re-read all workspace roots and reload the children of expanded directories (collapsed levels are left untouched).
把文件树里所有展开的目录折起来。只影响视图展开状态，不动磁盘。: Collapse every expanded directory in the file tree. This only changes view state and never touches disk.
关掉全部分组里的所有编辑器标签页（转发壳命令 core.closeAllEdit: Close every editor tab in all groups (forwards the shell command core.closeAllEditors). File-tree expansion and selection are untouched.
弹系统目录选择框，把选中的目录加进工作区。: Show the system folder picker and add the selected folder to the workspace.
把焦点挪到搜索面板的输入框（搜索面板常驻在文件树侧栏，本命令不切视图、不执行搜索: Move focus to the search panel's input (the panel lives in the file-tree sidebar; this command neither switches views nor runs a search—the user supplies the query).
打开一条搜索匹配行（等于在结果列表里双击那条）：按扩展名找属主插件开标签页。参数: Open a search result row (same as double-clicking it): open a tab via the plugin that owns the extension. By default opens the highlighted row; optionally pass filePath (and lineNumber). Requires existing search results, otherwise it errors.
{ filePath?, lineNumber? }——缺省为当前高亮那条: { filePath?, lineNumber? } — defaults to the currently highlighted row
把目标文件夹从当前工作区移除（⛔ 不删盘）。传右键项（FileMenuConte: Removes the target folder from the current workspace (does NOT delete it from disk). Pass the context-menu item (FileMenuContext.uri) to close that folder; omit it to close all workspace folders.
把入参项的 uri 记为 Diff 比较基准（不打开标签、不改盘）。传 {uri: Records the input item's uri as the Diff comparison base (opens no tab, writes nothing). Pass {uri}; no-op without a uri.
用 selectForCompare 记下的基准与入参项打开 Diff 标签（基: Opens a Diff tab between the base recorded by selectForCompare and the input item (the base is cleared afterwards). Pass {uri}; no-op without a base or for the same item.
